jargon: To optimize our meeting cadence, the weekly leadership sync will move to every other Tuesday starting next month.
plain: To save time, the weekly leadership meeting will happen every other Tuesday from next month.

jargon: Please be advised that due to industrial action on June 18, your elective procedure has been postponed and will be rebooked in due course.
plain: Because of a strike on June 18, your planned procedure is postponed. We'll give you a new date soon.

jargon: Kindly note that the promotional discount cannot be applied retroactively to orders placed prior to May 1.
plain: Please note that the discount can't be added to orders placed before May 1.

jargon: Prior to the commencement of the rental period, the hirer must present a valid driving license and a credit card in their own name.
plain: Before the rental, show a valid driver's license and a credit card in your name.

jargon: Going forward, all theses must be submitted electronically via the graduate school portal no later than May 1.
plain: From now on, submit all theses online through the graduate school portal by May 1.

jargon: The product team will ideate on features that could incentivize free users to upgrade to the Pro tier.
plain: The product team will brainstorm features that might get free users to upgrade to Pro.

jargon: Pursuant to the new flexible working policy, all employees may request compressed hours after 26 weeks of service.
plain: Under the new policy, after 26 weeks you can ask to work fewer, longer days.

jargon: The Office of Veterans Affairs is cognizant of delays in processing claims and is onboarding 40 additional caseworkers.
plain: The Office of Veterans Affairs knows claims are delayed. It is hiring 40 more caseworkers.

jargon: Herewith we provide the revised terms of service, which shall take effect on January 1 for all existing members.
plain: Here are the updated terms of service. They start on January 1 for all current members.

jargon: The guidance counselor will reach out to all Grade 12 students in order to schedule individual college planning meetings.
plain: The counselor will contact all Grade 12 students to book one-on-one college planning meetings.

jargon: To streamline the leave approval process, requests will now be routed directly to your team lead rather than HR.
plain: To make leave approval simpler, requests now go straight to your team lead, not HR.

jargon: Pursuant to our missed appointment policy, patients who fail to attend three appointments may be removed from the practice list.
plain: Under our rules, if you miss three appointments, you may be removed from our list of patients.

jargon: Our holistic support package includes setup, a 30-minute training session, and two years of phone support.
plain: Our full support covers setup, a 30-minute training session, and two years of phone help.

jargon: Tenants are hereby notified that the monthly rent for Unit 4B will increase to $1,450 with effect from August 1.
plain: The rent for Unit 4B will go up to $1,450 a month from August 1.

jargon: We are streamlining the check-in process, and patients can now confirm their arrival using the self-service screens in reception.
plain: Checking in is now easier. You can confirm you've arrived on the screens in reception.

jargon: This evaluation endeavours to assess the return on investment of the city's $4 million job training scheme.
plain: This review looks at whether the city's $4 million job training program was worth the money.

jargon: We're shifting to a two-week release cadence so customers get bug fixes faster.
plain: We'll release updates every two weeks so customers get bug fixes faster.

jargon: We are streamlining our returns process so that you can now print a prepaid label directly from your order history.
plain: We've made returns easier. You can now print a prepaid label from your order history.

jargon: The intervention sought to empower smallholder farmers through access to mobile weather forecasts and market prices.
plain: The program aimed to help small farmers through phone weather forecasts and market prices.

jargon: The faculty is cognizant that the new assessment model may increase marking workload by up to 20%.
plain: The faculty knows the new grading system may add up to 20% more marking work.

jargon: By accessing the service, you hereby agree to be bound by these terms and any amendments published on our website.
plain: By using the service, you agree to these terms. This includes any changes we post on our website.

jargon: We would like to touch base with parents of Year 9 students regarding GCSE option choices at an information evening on January 22.
plain: We'd like to meet Year 9 parents about GCSE subject choices. The information evening is on January 22.

jargon: Tenants are required to provide 24 hours' notice prior to moving large furniture via the service lift.
plain: Please give 24 hours' notice before moving large furniture in the service lift.

jargon: I want to double-click on the logistics costs slide; the 30% increase seems mission-critical to explain to the CFO.
plain: I want to study the logistics costs slide. The CFO needs the 30% rise explained.

jargon: Your personal data will be processed in accordance with our privacy policy and will not be sold to third parties.
plain: We'll handle your personal data as our privacy policy says. We won't sell it to other companies.

jargon: The transit authority is committed to optimizing service frequency on the Blue Line during peak hours.
plain: The transit authority wants to run Blue Line trains more often at busy times.

jargon: I'll reach out to Daniel in finance to ascertain whether the travel budget can absorb the Lisbon offsite.
plain: I'll ask Daniel in finance whether the travel budget can cover the Lisbon offsite.

jargon: The proposal aims to leverage existing community health workers in order to scale up malaria screening in rural Uganda.
plain: The proposal plans to use current community health workers to expand malaria testing in rural Uganda.

jargon: Our holistic security approach covers device management, encryption at rest, and quarterly penetration tests.
plain: Our security covers device management, encrypted stored data, and quarterly outside hacking tests.

jargon: To optimize desk usage, the hot-desking booking system will go live on all three floors from July 1.
plain: To use desks better, the desk booking system starts on all three floors on July 1.

jargon: The PTA will be reaching out to families regarding volunteer opportunities for the spring fair on May 17.
plain: The PTA will contact families about helping at the spring fair on May 17.

jargon: Our team is currently experiencing high call volumes; please utilize our online chat for faster assistance.
plain: We're very busy on the phones. Please use our online chat for faster help.

jargon: Line managers should touch base with their direct reports monthly to discuss workload and wellbeing.
plain: Managers should check in with each team member every month about workload and wellbeing.

jargon: Following feedback from stakeholders, the homework policy will be revised to cap homework at 30 minutes per night for grades 1 to 3.
plain: Based on feedback, we'll limit homework for grades 1 to 3 to 30 minutes a night.

jargon: Please send your actionable feedback on the draft strategy deck by end of day Wednesday.
plain: Please send useful comments on the draft strategy slides by Wednesday evening.

jargon: Notwithstanding the delay in the hardware shipment, we still expect the smart thermostat beta to start in October.
plain: Even though the hardware is late, we still expect the smart thermostat beta to start in October.

jargon: The aforementioned security deposit of $2,100 will be returned within 30 days of the end of the tenancy, less any deductions for damage.
plain: We'll return your $2,100 deposit within 30 days after the lease ends, minus any money for damage.

jargon: Please be advised that the Westfield passport office will be closed with immediate effect for urgent repairs.
plain: The Westfield passport office is closed now for urgent repairs.

jargon: The Department of Transportation is seeking input from stakeholders on proposed changes to the Route 9 bus service.
plain: The Department of Transportation wants your views on planned changes to the Route 9 bus.

jargon: Staff are requested to utilize the new self-service portal to submit expense claims and holiday requests.
plain: Please use the new online portal to send expense claims and holiday requests.

jargon: The management company is looking to optimize parking allocation and will issue new permits to all residents by March 1.
plain: The management company wants to share out parking better. Every resident will get a new permit by March 1.

jargon: We would appreciate it if you could provide feedback on your recent stay in Ward 7 at your earliest convenience.
plain: We'd like to hear about your recent stay on Ward 7. Please send feedback when you can.

jargon: The board of governors will drill down into the budget shortfall of $85,000 at its meeting on Monday, February 3.
plain: The school board will review the $85,000 budget gap on Monday, February 3.

jargon: In the event that you fail to respond within 28 days, your claim for council tax reduction will be closed.
plain: If you don't reply within 28 days, we'll close your claim for a council tax discount.

jargon: To move the needle on employee retention, we are piloting a four-day week for the Leeds office starting September.
plain: To keep more staff, we're testing a four-day week in the Leeds office from September.

jargon: Going forward, all residents must utilize the designated recycling area behind Building A for cardboard and plastics.
plain: From now on, use the recycling area behind Building A for cardboard and plastic.

jargon: You hereby consent to receive marketing communications, which you may opt out of at any time by clicking unsubscribe.
plain: You agree to get marketing emails. You can stop them any time by clicking unsubscribe.

jargon: In order to reduce cold-start times, we'll move the image service from serverless functions to always-on containers.
plain: To start faster, the image service will move from serverless functions to always-on containers.

jargon: We aim to deliver a best-in-class experience, and we're sorry your recent flight from Dublin did not meet that standard.
plain: We aim to give great service. We're sorry your recent flight from Dublin fell short.

jargon: The care team will touch base with your family prior to any changes being made to your care plan.
plain: The care team will talk to your family before changing your care plan.
